messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] error while creating grid coverage layer
parts:
Nikunj

This is a common problem people have when creating a coverage grid.  I most recently answered this question on 9 September 2014.  You could search the GoogleGroups email list for either the content of your error message "Error raised from: Distance.ClsGrid.SetDefault" or the cause of the error "LinkID" and you will find previous answers to this question.

You have not imported the shapefile of your study area properly. Read the Users Guide section in Chapter 5 entitled "Importing Existing GIS Data | Prepare the Shapefile"  that will tell you to create a field called LinkID in your shapefile to solve this problem.

messages.author: 49645c2345c6813a
messages.subject: Re: error while creating grid coverage layer
parts:
hello everybody,

with the help of distance team, the error was resolved. the shapefile which was copied to the .dat folder has value '0' (in arcmap) and 'null' in qgis in the LinkID field. (also keep in mind, LinkID field is case sensitive, so be careful while creating new field)  all you have to do is change the value to '1' and its done. if you are using arcgis, to edit field value you will have to start editor->start edit and then open attributes table and change the value. then click on save edits and stop editing. 

also, after that, i had error with co-ordinate system. while designing survey you must keep in mind that the co-ordinate system of the project properties and the shapefile you have uploaded should be the same. for eg, it should be 'none' in both of them, or 'WGS1984' (in my case) in both.  

i hope everybody finds it useful.

regards
